notes: Search snippets (PubMed/SAGE pages not openable) confirm Cai X, ..., Shou W (BMS), ASSAY Drug Dev Technol, online 26 Dec 2025, DOI 10.1177/1540658X251408742: 24- to 96-well Caco-2 on an integrated culture+assay platform with cleaning, plate tracking and dynamic scheduling; 94% of 50 literature compounds classified as in 24-well. Peer-reviewed; concordance is categorical (no Papp R2, throughput or hardware in the abstract), so 'matching' means same permeability class only.

Snippets from PubMed/DMD/ScienceDirect confirm Wen X, Wang J, Li X, Xing L, Chen G, Tao Y, Shen L (WuXi AppTec DMPK), DMD 53(12):100200, Epub 10 Nov 2025 (WuXi paper listing): AEMS fu vs LC-MS/MS R2 > 0.96, vs literature R2 > 0.95, 25-fold faster. Peer-reviewed but small (10 reference compounds, human plasma); the 25x is readout speed (about 3 s/sample, 30 nL), not whole-assay time.

Snippets of PMC7567642 / journal page confirm Wernevik J et al. (AstraZeneca), ASSAY Drug Dev Technol 18(4):157-179, DOI 10.1089/adt.2020.970, ahead of print 14 May 2020: DMPK Wave 1 (HLM and rat hepatocyte CLint, human PPB, dried-DMSO solubility, logD7.4) run weekly on all synthesised compounds on three identically configured Hamilton Microlab STARplus. 'No big pharma has published newer throughput figures' is editorial; AZ's own 2021 ADDT letter on acoustic dispensing/384-well workflows to raise Wave 1 capacity exists and was not checked for figures.

Snippets (ACS, PMC12505271, SDU portal) confirm Beran K ...
